book.name: Luka
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Luka

content: Yecho abhatuma bhabholwa kome na bhabhele
Yecho ajhakwakema bhabholwa bhake kome na bhabhele, ajhakwapekeya makakala pamonga na ukindendeke panane jha michuka jhoha na kulamicha ulwalo ghoghoha,
peniya ndi ajhakwatuma bhajhende bhakatangache Malobhe gha Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga na kulamicha bhibhalwalwa.
Ajhakwalobholela papalapala, alongila, “Nkotoka kughegha kilebhe chochoha mu mwanja gwino, hilu nkongocho, hilu lihako na ilebhe ya kulyegha amu mbijha amu ngobho ya kujhangangana.
Bhahe, pa nyumba jhojhoha jhipala kujhingila na kupokelwa, ntame mwenio ade pupala kubhoka.
Bhando anda bhakanite kumpokela, ndi mumokengane pa muche gwenio, na pumpala kukitabhuka makung'undila lutukunda lwa mu magholo gwino kwalangiya nginyililo kubhehe bhakajhonikiye jhe.”
Bhahe, bhajhakubhoka na kujhenda chenda jhimo na jhenge kwalobholela bhando Lilobhe lya Mbone na kwalamicha bhibhalwalwa kila chehemo.
Kiholo cha nkolongwa Helode
Nkolongwa Helode jwa ku Galilaya pajhohina ilebhe yoha itendika, ajhakubhehe na kiholo nhwalo bhando bhange bhalongila, “Yohane Mbatichajhe ayokite!”
Bhange bhalongila, Eliya apitile na bhange bhalongila jwenio ndi jhumo jwa bhalondole bha Chapanga, bhibhakibha makacho ayokite.
Nambo Helode akalongile, “Yohane nikahekite muto bho, Yohane ghane kabhele jhubhanongela?”
Yecho abhapeke chakulya bhando elufo nhwano
Akatenga bhala pubhabhujhita, bhajhakunobholela Yecho ghoha ghubhatehile. Yecho ajhakwatola na kujhenda nabho ade ku muche gwa ku Betisaida bhabhii kanjika chabhe.
Peniya lilongo lya bhando pulimanyita kwajhingilile Yecho, bhajhakunkengama. Yecho ajhakwapokela na kulonge nabho ilebhe ya Unahota gwa Chapanga, na helahela kwalamicha bhubhalwalita.

Lyobha pulitumbwila kutipika, akatenga bhala kome na bhabhele bhajhakunnobholela Yecho, “Mwulitabhuke lilongo lya bhando leno bhajhende mu chenda ya pahina bhakapalahe yakulyegha na pakugholoka nhwalo putubhii pano tubhii panjenga.”

Nambo Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Mangota mapelengane ilebhe yakulyegha bheniya.” Bhene ngabhajhangwila, “Tukwete mabumunda nhwano tugha na homba ibhele. Anda naha tujhende tukahemele ilebhe yakukwela kulyegha lilongo lyoha leno.”
Bhahe, bhakibha akanalome elufo nhwano. Yecho ajhakwalobholela bhabholwa bhake, “Bhatame muibhogha ya bhando makome nhwano.”
Bhabholwa bhala bhajhakutenda ngita chibhalaghalikiye, bhajhakwalobholela bhando bhoha bhatame pahe.
Peniya Yecho ajhakutola mabumunda nhwano ghala na homba ibhele. Ajhakulola kunane kwa Chapanga ajhakunchenguu Chapanga, ajhakumetulana na kwapekeya bhabholwa bhake bhapekehe bhando bhala.
Bhando bhoha bhakalile na kujhukuta. Na bhabholwa bhakujhola mahighiliko gha chakulya yoha, ijhakutwelela ichukilo kome na ibhele.
Petile kwa nnomo gwake ilonge Yecho ndi Kilichitu
Lichiko limo Yecho anyopita Chapanga kanjika chake, panga bhando, na bhabholwa bhake bhakibha pahina jhake, peniya ndi ajhakwakonya, “Bho, bhando bhalonge nenga na ghane?”

Bhabholwa bhala bhajhakunyangu, “Bhando bhilongela mwenga ndi mwa Yohane Mbatichajhe na bhange bhilongela mwenga ndi mwa Eliya na helahela bhando bhange bhilongela mwenga ndi jhumo jwa milondole bha makacho bha Chapanga uyokite.”
Papalapala Yecho ajhakwakonya, “Bho, mangota mwenga mihola nenga na ghane?” Nambo Petile ngajhangwila, “Mwenga ndi Kilichitu jhuhumite kwa Chapanga.”
Yecho ilonge kuwe kwake
Bhahe, Yecho ajhakwapwatalila bhakotoka kunnobholela mundo jhonge malobhe gheniya.

Yecho pajhendilila kulonge, “Mwana gwa Mundo nalunkolela lung'ahe lukolongwa na kukanwa na ighogholo na Akapiya matambiko bhakolo pamonga na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo. Nabhankoma, na machiko matato anda ghahikite peniya nayoka.”
Peniya ajhakwalobholela bhando bhoha, “Mundo jhojhoha jwapala kubhehe na nenga, akihila hote jwenio na ilebhe yake, nambo atole nchalaba gwake angengame kila lichiko.
Nhwalo mundo jhojhoha jwapala kuukombola ughome gwake nahuobhecha, nambo jwahuobhecha ughome kwa nhwalo gwa Yecho, naghombokoka mu ughome gwa machiko ghoha.
Nakitangatila nike mundo kupata ilebhe mbwe ya pannema pano, kongo ahuobhiche ughome gwake?

Mundo jhojhoha jwangolela hone nenga na mabholo ghango, helahela Mwana gwa Mundo, nakolela hone mundo jwenio machiko pughapala kuhika mu ung'alicho gwake na ung'alicho gwa Tate na gwa akatumiche bha kunane kwa Chapanga bhanyahinyahi.
Nambo ninnobholela chakaka, bhabhii bhando bhange pambano pano nabhawejhe kabula jha kubhona Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga.”
Yecho ighalambuka mwonekano gwake
Ghakapetite machiko nane Yecho palongela gheniya, ndi ajhakwatola Petile na Yohane na Yakobu kujhenda ku itombe kunyopa Chapanga.
Pakibha anyopita Chapanga, kumiho kwake kujhakughalambuka, na ngobho ijhakubhehe unho ya mbumbumbu na kung'anyima ng'anyima ngita lumule lwa mbamba.
Papalapala bhando bhabhele bhabhonikina akalongela nabho, bhakibha Mucha na Eliya.
Bhene bhabhonikina bhabhii na ukolo gwa Chapanga, ndi bhalonginako Yecho chela chikipala kujhomolela lihengo lyake ngita chapala Chapanga, kwa jwenio kuwegha kukupala kutendeka ku Yeluchalemo.
Petile na bhajhake bhukakibha mulughono tipitipi, pibhang'ang'anwika bhakauwene ung'alicho gwa Yecho, na bhando bhala bhabhele bhakajhemite nabho.

Bhahe, Mucha na Eliya pubhabhokita, Petile ajhakunobholela Yecho, “Bhambo, nibhona pambano pambone hake kutama twenga! Mbaha tuchenge ichimba itato, chimo chino, chimo cha Mucha na chimo cha Eliya.” Nambo Petile akamanyite ndeka chalongila.
Petile pajhendilila kulonge gheniya, papa lihunde lijhakwayekelela, na lihunde lyenio palibhaheghelila bhabholwa bhala, na bhene bhajhakujhoghopa hake.
Peniya lilobhe kuhumii kulihunde lela, “Jhonjo ndi Mwanango jhunihagwile, munyokanikiya jwenio.”
Lilobhe lela pulikotwika kulonge, Yecho abhonikina kanjika chake. Bhabholwa bhake bhakaliyalite lilobhe lyenio kumwojho gwabhe changannobholela mundo jhonge ghoha ghughatendika kwenio.
Yecho inamicha nchongolo jwabhii na michuka
Kilabho jhake, Yecho pamonga na bhabholwa bhake bhatato bhala pubhahelila kuhumii ku katombe kola, bhakakonganike na lilongo lya bhando.
Peniya akibha mundo jhumo kuhumii palilongo lela alalima na kulonge, “Mmola, chonde uningukiye mwanango!
Machiko gwamahele uchikilwa na kuntenda alalame, kugwiya pahe na kuntenda kihinduhindu na lihulohulo upita munnomo, na ujhendelela kung'ahicha ade akochokane.
Nambo nakajhopite bhabholwa bhino bhahibhohe michuka jhene, nambo bhakahotwi ndeka.”
Yecho pajhangwila, “Mangota kibheleko changabhehe na kihobholelo, nandama na mangota mwenga nanihimbilila ade ligha? Ndi ajhakunnobholela mundo jhola, munete mwana gwino pambano.”

Papalapala mwana jhola panheghelila Yecho, nchuka ghola ujhakugwiya pahe na kuntenda kihinduhindu. Nambo Yecho ajhakuhupwatalila na kuhubhenga nchuka na kunamicha mwana jhola, na kukamuya kwa tate mundo.

Bhando bhoha bhakakangiche hake uhotolo nkolongwa gwa Chapanga. Yecho abhujhii kulonge kabhele kuwe kwake Matei 17:22-23; Maluku 9:30-32 Bhando bhala pubhajhendilila kukangacha ilebhe itendike, Yecho ajhakwalobholela bhabholwa bhake,
“Unyokanikiye mbone malobhe ghinipala kunnobholela ghano, Mwana gwa Mundo natendwa kujhambilwa na kubhekwa mu mabhoko gha bhando.”
Nambo bhabholwa bhake bhakamanyite ndeka chela chabhalongolila. Lilobhe lyenio likatei kuhihywa bhakoto kumanya, bhene bhajhakunyoghopa kunkonya Yecho panane jha lyenio.
Ndi ghane nkolongwa?
Peniya bhabholwa bhake bhajhakutumbula kutaungana bhene chika, ghane nkolongwa pakate jhabhe.
Nambo Yecho akamanyite chibhahola kumwojho gwabhe. Ndi ajhakuntola mwana nchokombe ko, ajhakummeka pahina jhabhe,

na peniya kwalobholela, “Mundo jwampokela mwana nchokombe ngita jhonjo kwa liina lyango, jwenio ambokii nenga, na jhojhoha jwambokii nenga, apokile jwandumita, anda mundo nchokombe abhii pakate jhino, jwenio ndi nkolongwa.”
Mundo jhojhoha jwangatukana abhii pamonga na twenga
Yohane ajhakujhangila kulonge, “Bhambo, tunkolile mundo abhenga michuka kwa liina lino na twenga tujhakunkelebhuya nhwalo jwenio abhii jhe pamonga na twenga.”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Nkotoka kuhibhilikiya, nhwalo mundo jhojhoha jwangatukana abhii pamonga na twenga.”
Bhando bha chenda jha ku Samaliya bhikana kunpokela Yecho
Machiko gha Yecho gha kutolwa kujhenda kunane kwa Chapanga pughabhandikila, Yecho ajhakughagha hake kujhenda ku Yeluchalemo,
bhahe, ajhakwatuma bhando bhanongolele, bhene bhajhakujhenda na kujhingila pachenda jhimo jha ku Samaliya, bhakalenganikiye kila kilebhe kibhehe telatela.
Bhahe, akolo chenda bha peniya, bhakapahii jhe kunpokela Yecho nhwalo bhakamanyite Yecho ajhenda ku Yeluchalemo.
Nambo bhabholwa bhake, Yakobu na Yohane pubhalolita gheniya, bhajhakunobholela, “Bhambo, bho, mipala tulaghalikihe mwotu kuhumii kunane kwa Chapanga gwakomelekeye?”
Papalapala Yecho ajhakwaghalambukila, na kwapwatalila,
peniya Yecho na bhabholwa bhake bhajhakubhoka na kutyangila chenda jhenge.
Ghighapalwa kunkengama Yecho
Pubhatyangita undela, mundo jhumo ajhakunnobholela Yecho, “Naninkengama mwenga kokoha kola kumijhenda.”
Yecho panyangwila, “Mabweya ghabhii na mikwembe jhabhe na ijhune ibhii na mihuhe jhabhe, nambo Mwana gwa Mundo akwete ndeka pakujhebhelekeya lubhaho lwake.”
Nambo Yecho ajhakunnobholela mundo jhonge, “Ungengame.” Na mundo jhola ajhakujhanguu, “Bhambo, uneke nyende hote kajha, nikachike tate gwango.”
Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Mwaleke bhubhawile bhachikane bhene chika, mwenga nnyende mukatangache Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga.”
Papalapala mundo jhonge helahela ajhakulonge, “Bhambo, naninkengama, nambo nyenda hote kajha kwatabhuka akalongo bhango.”
Nambo Yecho panyangwila, “Mundo jhojhoha jwakamula lighela kulema, kongo ighalambuka na kulola kuhyeto, jwenio chatangatila kibhiijhe mu Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga.”
